who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), lane IN (intrinsics tempo refuses) on rebuild-1115
what: Reading back an integer constant from LIR to check an immediate (xar's rotate amount) has three encodings to know: `iconst` of 32 bits or fewer is one word, `iconst` of a wider type is one word holding a sign-extended i32, and anything else is `iconst_wide` with `const_words()` words. `Operands::constant()` reads `const_words()` words, which is wrong for `iconst` of an i64 (it reads past the one word). simd.rs `const_index` and sha3.rs each decode it by hand.
cost: about ten minutes, caught by reading builder.rs before the build
cause: no one accessor on a view answers 'the value of this integer constant, if it is one'
whys: the compact iconst form was added to builder.rs without a matching reader; each reader decodes the words itself
class: an encoding with several forms and no reader invites a decode that is right for one form only
prevention: wanted: `View::int_const(value) -> Option<u128>` in blaze-lir covering iconst and iconst_wide, and the hand decoders (simd.rs const_index, sha3.rs rotate_amount, the barrier immediate) moved to it
workaround: sha3.rs decodes both forms itself, refusing iconst_wide as out of range
